nodes.label: AP-0007 — Runtime-Agnostic Core and Adapter Contract
nodes.author: Raphael Caveagna — Founder & Chief Vision Officer
nodes.rationale: The core must never know or depend on Codex, Claude Code, GPT, Gemini, Cursor, Fable, n8n or any specific runtime; runtime-specific tools live exclusively behind adapters. Model agnosticism is a consequence; runtime agnosticism is the wider constraint.
